name: Hierarchical DDA with Chunk Stepping
aliases: Voxel Ray Marching with DDA & Chunk Stepping
definition: Traces a ray through a hierarchical voxel map by stepping through chunks using a 3D DDA algorithm, detecting solid chunks, converting to local coordinates, and continuing the ray until a hit is found or bounds are exceeded.
summary: Hierarchical DDA with Chunk Stepping traces rays through voxel maps by skipping empty space at the chunk level while maintaining a hierarchical structure for large-step traversal.
